newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Parmelia to become Voyager Gold NL.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Parmelia to become Voyager Gold NL.

text.p: Parmelia Resources NL said on Tuesday that its shareholders had approved a change in the company's name to Voyager Gold NL as part of a restructuring which included a A$2.5 million capital raising.

"As a result, the company now has new management and is well positioned to pursue a strategy of acquiring properties with the potential to achieve early gold production, both in Western Australia and overseas," Parmelia said. Parmelia shares have been suspended from trading since March 1996.
